about_the_game:
Max’s Adventure: Christmas Edition is a lighthearted, choice-driven adventure that follows the story of Max — a wildly imaginative and mischievous kid spending Christmas Eve at home.

When his dad doesn’t return from work, Max’s restless curiosity takes over, and what starts as a quiet night quickly unravels into a series of unpredictable and hilarious events. Guided by a charming narrator whose story you can follow — or completely derail — you’ll shape Max’s chaotic evening through your decisions.

As he drifts into a vivid Christmas dream, Max finds himself in a magical world filled with twinkling lights, a bustling Christmas market, and an entire town brimming with festive wonder. But Christmas Land isn’t all joy and candy canes — Santa has gone missing, and it’s up to Max to find him.
Along the way, Max will play mischievous mini-games, climb (or fall down) the Naughty and Nice ranking board, and discover that sometimes being a little bad can make for one unforgettable holiday.

🕹️ Gameplay & Features

• Interactive storytelling: Every choice you make shapes the story — from Max’s actions to the narrator’s reactions. Follow the story faithfully or push it off the rails to uncover hidden scenes and outcomes.

• Exploration-based gameplay: Move freely through Max’s home and the whimsical world of Christmas Land, discovering secrets, surprises, and delightful interactions at every corner.

• Dynamic narration: The story is told by a fully voiced narrator who adapts to your decisions, commenting, guiding, or panicking as you test the limits of the tale.

• Naughty or Nice ranking: Your choices affect your standing on the Naughty and Nice board — unlock alternate dialogues, scenes, and endings based on your behavior.

• Mini-games and moments of mischief: Take part in playful activities that blend humor and holiday chaos — from sneaky pranks to heartfelt surprises.

• Multiple endings: Replay to explore different choices, reactions, and story paths for a new experience every time.

• A cozy, comedic tone: A heartwarming and funny adventure that captures the magic, mischief, and wonder of Christmas Eve.
